question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers
alternative: SELECT SUM(1) AS customer_count FROM customers

question: What is gross revenue?
sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS gross_revenue FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed'
alternative: SELECT SUM(amount) AS gross_revenue FROM (SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS amount FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) i WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status='completed')

question: What is net revenue?
sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price*(1-i.discount)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed'

question: How many orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

question: How many orders are completed?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

question: Show order counts by region
sql: SELECT c.region,COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

question: Show gross revenue by category
sql: SELECT p.category,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS gross_revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: Show the five most expensive products
sql: SELECT name,price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show monthly order counts
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',order_date) AS month,COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Show products with no sales
sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items i ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE i.product_id IS NULL
